page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 40 vCPUs derived from 20 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. The system features 192.0 GB of RAM, equating to 4.8 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external storage solutions, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the CPU performance in the average tier, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. The Intel Xeon processor supports AVX-512 vector instructions, contributing to a PassMark CPU extended instructions score of 35214.09. Memory bandwidth is measured at 2133.36 GB/sec for cached small blocks and drops to 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. In application-specific tests, the server achieves 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the system processes 135M parameter LLM prompts at 1841.39 tokens per second, though performance drops to 56.94 tokens per second for 7B parameter models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio provide predictable compute resources without the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU hardware. This makes the instance appropriate for workloads that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity, such as database operations, software compilation, and static web serving, while avoiding the premium costs associated with specialized accelerator hardware.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 server featuring 40 vCPUs and 192.0 GB of RAM, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz on a KVM hypervisor. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, utilizing a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results indicate steady mid-range performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 38378.07 and a PassMark CPU score of 34691.95. Memory bandwidth reaches 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, while database operations score 14249.04 on PassMark. The server processes 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and serves static web traffic at 25.35 GB/sec. This hardware profile is optimized for workloads such as database management, web serving, and software compilation, offering a balanced resource density without the added cost of integrated storage or GPUs.
